sections.h2: Only about 12% of the mission outlay had reached institutions by February 2026

chart.title: Only ₹699.50 crore of ₹2,330.68 crore sanctioned had been released by February 2026
chart.sub: Released and sanctioned amounts, ₹ crore, to February 2026.
chart.source: Lok Sabha answer of 4 February 2026 (PIB 2223187), as reported.

sections.means: Releases of ₹699.50 crore against ₹2,330.68 crore sanctioned show that about 12% of the ₹6,003.65 crore outlay had reached institutions by February 2026.

sections.h2: The 2024-25 budget was revised down to ₹86 crore, and releases were smaller still

chart.title: 2024-25: ₹86 crore revised from ₹427 crore budgeted; ₹43.07 crore released
chart.source: Union Budget documents, as reported; Policy Circle.

sections.means: The budget, revised, released and used figures for 2024-25 differ several times over, and another analysis gives actual spending of 62.36, so annual spending cannot be read from one source.

sections.h2: Secure communication is the one pillar the forces have bought

chart.title: Communication moved from trials to a 2024 contract and a 2025 rollout
chart.source: PIB releases from the Ministry of Defence; trade press listed in the post.
events: Ministry of Defence says it will adopt QNu Labs’ 150 km QKD system
Army signs a procurement contract for QNu Labs’ QKD system
Army says post-quantum cryptography is being integrated across its networks
DRDO completes military field trials of a fibre QKD system with Taqbit Labs

sections.means: Secure communication is the only pillar with equipment on contract and software being rolled out, while computing, sensing and materials remain at laboratory, prototype or import stage.
sections.todo: Use QKD for fixed links between headquarters and rely on post-quantum cryptography for wider networks, as the post argues.
